issue_request: FHIR-22496 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for R5 asking CodeSystem $lookup to return a new optional output parameter named definition, defined as a statement of the meaning of a concept from the code system.

additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/CodeSystem-lookup, confirming the inspected XML is current build input. reconciliation: No source change was made because source/codesystem/operationdefinition-CodeSystem-lookup.xml already defines an out parameter named definition with min 0, max 1, documentation "A statement of the meaning of the concept from the code system", and type string.
